images.name: Opaline Divide
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic environment concept art for the antigravity racing game Vector Nova, one standalone wide landscape image.
Primary request: OPALINE DIVIDE. An alien river has carved a continent of porcelain into enormous bowls, folded cliffs, and smooth spillways. Dark iridescent fluid moves through the depths, throwing shifting green light onto pale overhangs. The racing course begins on an engineered causeway, then merges directly into a broad mineral shelf. The landscape supplies the banking: polished channels curl around basins, narrow beneath overlapping strata, and open onto exposed terraces. Short constructed bridges connect broken shelves before surrendering to terrain again. The defining passage runs inside a translucent mineral wall, with the river moving behind its thin surface and casting enormous traveling shadows across the road.
Composition: one coherent, immersive view, camera a few metres above the racing surface looking forward along its banked sweep. Foreground shows the precise transition from a short elegant engineered connector onto the smooth porcelain shelf itself. The shelf leads through a great translucent folded overhang in the middle distance; beyond it opens a spectacular deep canyon of nested mineral basins and dark green iridescent water far below. Clearly legible surface continuity, strong foreground/middle/background depth. Two small sleek antigravity racing craft give scale, secondary to the landscape.
Visual treatment: premium science fiction game environment key art, convincing sculpted 3D forms, physically plausible materials, cinematic but readable lighting, detailed surfaces and coherent large shapes. Ivory porcelain strata, pearly translucent edges, cool lilac shadows, restrained emerald caustics, airborne mineral dust in shafts of soft daylight. Surface wear, layered mineral deposits and fine fractures distinguish ceramic geology from snow or ice.
Constraints: the drivable mineral shelf is genuinely part of the canyon, NOT a separate asphalt road laid through scenery. No Earth trees or grass, no lane markings on natural surfaces, no generic neon highway, no HUD, no text, no watermark, no collage. Show a beautiful alien place with a clear racing route.

images.name: Ferric Tide
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic environment concept art for the antigravity racing game Vector Nova, one standalone wide landscape image.
Primary request: FERRIC TIDE. A metallic ocean solidified during a planetary storm, preserving waves the size of mountains. Blackened crests curl above champagne-silver troughs; fractured edges reveal layers of copper and violet oxidation. The entire racing course follows the ocean's hardened shape. Racers sweep through broad troughs, climb the concave faces of waves, and cross fractures onto the next rolling formation. Rough buckled metal borders naturally polished racing surfaces. The centerpiece is a colossal breaking wave forming an almost enclosed barrel. The route climbs inside its curved wall, passes beneath a ceiling of suspended metallic spray, and escapes through a torn opening onto an exposed crest overlooking the sea.
Composition: one coherent view from a low elevated chase-camera position within the entrance of the immense wave barrel. A broad smooth solid-metal trough in the foreground bends up the concave side of the wave and leads visibly toward a torn opening ahead. The crest curls overhead in immense heavy sculptural folds, with branching frozen metal droplets and jagged oxidized outer edges. Through the opening, distant mountains of curled metallic waves recede toward a pale violet horizon. Two tiny sleek antigravity craft skim the polished solid surface, giving scale and clearly communicating racing. Preserve readable large-scale curvature rather than busy spaghetti forms.
Visual treatment: premium science fiction game environment key art, tactile physically believable 3D metal, spectacular low raking sunlight, deep cool shadows with readable detail. Champagne silver running surfaces, gunmetal backs of waves, copper fracture interiors, restrained violet patina. Differentiated roughness and subtle scratches, dramatic bright reflections shaped by curvature without mirror clutter. Air is mostly clear with a little distant haze.
Constraints: the wave itself IS the road; no separate racetrack deck, no asphalt, no railings, no painted lanes, no constructed bridge. This is solid sculptural metal, not water, ice, lava, or sand. The running surfaces must look broad and traversable, smoothly joined into the world. No HUD, no text, no watermark, no collage.

images.name: Morrow Engine
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic environment concept art for the antigravity racing game Vector Nova, one standalone wide landscape image.
Primary request: MORROW ENGINE. An ancient planetary machine has developed its own internal climate. Condensation falls through cavernous chambers; mineral deposits cover dormant mechanisms; warm mist escapes into a cold indigo exterior. Its purpose is unclear, but something deep inside still turns. The racing route alternates between installed service bridges and the machine's actual surfaces: broad drainage channels, worn bearing grooves, and curved shell interiors. Outside are immense oxidized plates overlooking a wilderness of fins and vents. Inside are intimate passages illuminated by reflected copper light. The central landmark is an enormous exposed bearing surrounding a slowly rotating core. Racers follow its stationary inner groove, disappear behind machinery, then emerge through a fractured housing into rain and open sky.
Composition: one coherent expansive view from a few metres above a broad curved bearing groove, looking forward as the groove sweeps around the bottom and side of a truly monumental exposed circular core. The worn stationary metal groove is the actual racing surface, integrated into the mechanism, with two small sleek antigravity craft for scale. A short service connector joins it in the foreground. Frame the far side with a broken machine housing revealing a cold indigo exterior and a wilderness of vast oxidized fins. Layer huge mechanisms and shadowed chambers at different depths; give the core a clear imposing silhouette rather than a busy nest of pipes.
Visual treatment: premium cinematic science fiction game environment key art, convincing sculpted 3D geometry and aged materials, beautifully controlled lighting. Deep blue ambient rain light enters through broken shell openings, balanced by warm copper reflections from the distant slowly active core. Wet dark alloy, verdigris streaks, mineral crust, bronze wear-polished bearing surfaces, fine condensation and localized vapor. A solemn enormous place, neither pristine factory nor generic neon cyberpunk. High detail on close materials, increasingly simplified atmospheric distant silhouettes.
Constraints: clearly show driving along the machine itself, not a standard road floating in front of it. Immense scale but a legible continuous route; machinery is architecture and landscape. Avoid a bright sci-fi portal replacing the physical core, excessive emissive strips, conventional asphalt, city skylines, people, HUD, text, watermark, or collage.
